goal: Audit the MS01/MS02 authoring formats and propose a non-invasive, backward-compatible Authoring Format Contract v1 for future website consumption.

in_scope: Inventory 13 selected lesson/companion pairs across pinned MS01/MS02 branch commits and review-backed revision paths.
Document a candidate v1 content format covering YAML, Markdown, examples, diagrams, assessment variants, asset safety and backward compatibility.
Record identified limitations and a staged follow-on plan for parser validation, loader, approval and web rendering.

Wire the candidate contract into future authoring through a compact shared content-format skill, module-pipeline handoff and new task template declared inputs, without modifying existing lesson/assessment authoring skills.
out_of_scope: Change or regenerate any lesson, assessment, source evidence, review verdict, existing lesson-authoring/assessment-design skills, provider-specific agent profiles or existing content validator.
Execute new format validation, build a loader, add a publication gate, merge milestone branches, deploy a website or approve content.
Introduce any additional LLM step/token usage in future milestone content generation.

constraints: Keep SDA-v1 approved curriculum and MS01/MS02 artifact bytes unchanged.
Documentation is a candidate, not an enforced authoring standard; human review required before activation.
Use exact inspected branch snapshots; distinguish raw observations from runtime test claims.
Follow the existing issue/spec/state/worklog convention; do not claim taskctl verification unless executed.

Avoid editing existing lesson-authoring and assessment-design skills because their hashes are declared inputs of completed MS01/MS02 author steps; new authoring tasks must explicitly reference the compact format skill instead.

definition_of_done.text: A candidate backward-compatible format contract is committed on a separate branch for human review.
A reproducible content-format audit records pinned source commits, selected revisions, syntax variants and explicit gaps.
Verify documentation and repository checks where executable, recording checks not run rather than inventing results.
New author tasks are given a short content-format skill and authoritative contract path without an additional agent or rewrite of older lesson artifacts.

acceptance_criteria.text: No existing lesson/assessment/integrated output, reviewer verdict, authoring behavior or public visibility is changed.
Audit identifies M01-L02 and M02-L02 revision-1 selection and alternate Answer/Explanation formatting.
Follow-on stages are explicitly separate: validation, thin loader, publication gate and frontend.
Do not mark automation complete or claim CLI tests pass without taskctl/test execution.
Explicitly prioritize learning outcomes, truth and pedagogy over format and flag missing presentation capabilities instead of reducing lesson content.
Existing tracked authoring skills are untouched; new author task inputs bind the format skill and contract for future fingerprinting.
